title: Separate pre-game 90-minute active/inactive lineup adjustments from starter-blind team ratings
problem: pipeline/models.py fits Elo/matchup/ridge on team scores and rest only; starter outs (e.g., QB1/CB1/OL cascades to 2nd–4th string) leave team ratings at full-strength levels.
proposal: Prevents originating stale spreads/totals when 1st- or 2nd-string starters are ruled Out or DNP (walk-forward PBP diagnostic shows large negative scoring residuals under backup QBs/RBs).
options_a: Path A (No-model gate): Keep models.py unchanged; add a manual/automated 'Lineup Alert Hold' flag that blocks bets whenever QB1 or >=2 unit starters are Out/DNP.
options_b: Path B (Two-stage prior adjustment — Recommended): Keep base team rating frozen, apply an out-of-fold estimated positional replacement delta at T-85 min once official club inactives publish.
options_c: Path C (Player-level bottom-up rating): Rebuild team spread/total origination from snap-weighted 53-man player ratings across all 22 offensive/defensive slots.
risk: Path A avoids estimation error but discards high-edge injury games; Path C needs multi-season snap-count licensing; Path B captures starter-to-backup drop-offs with auditable shrinkage.

title: Reconcile club 'Unofficial' depth charts with official NFL injury reports and mid-week transactions
problem: 2026-11-12 audit proved club depth charts carry explicit 'Unofficial' disclaimers and omit active trade/injury names (e.g., Kirk Cousins on MIN, Micah Parsons on GB, Lucas Patrick on WAS).
proposal: Eliminates false confidence in 2nd/3rd/4th-string identity before sizing sides, totals, or backup player props.
options_a: Path A (Discrepancy block): Flag any game/position with an injury-vs-depth mismatch as UNRESOLVED and suppress automated signal generation.
options_b: Path B (Prior-snap + official report fusion — Recommended): Combine prior-week official game-book offensive/defensive snap shares with Wednesday–Friday NFL.com practice/game statuses.
options_c: Path C (Commercial real-time depth feed): License an official NFL data distributor feed with transaction-synchronized depth ladders.
risk: Path A is zero-cost and safe; Path B uses verifiable game-book participation rather than writer-maintained club tables; Path C adds recurring vendor cost.

title: Build a prospective pre-kickoff executable quote & bet-limit logger to unlock Gate G1
problem: 0% of the 26,149 historical backtest tickets carry an authenticated sportsbook timestamp, house rulebook link, or bet limit; G1 fails closed for all 18 strategies.
proposal: Without executable entry and closing quotes from regulated operators, neither CLV nor realized ROI can be distinguished from stale community consensus numbers.
options_a: Path A (Paper-log single book): Archive timestamped pre-kickoff snapshots (T-24h, T-90m, T-5m) from one regulated operator with SHA-256 manifests.
options_b: Path B (Multi-book prospective ledger — Recommended): Log synchronized quotes, vig, and posted limits across >=3 regulated books plus operator settlement rules at each NFL injury/inactive milestone.
options_c: Path C (Historical commercial odds purchase): License historical tick-level opener-to-closer archives with verified bookmaker IDs.
risk: Path C is retroactive but still lacks personal account limits; Path B creates an unimpeachable prospective audit trail aligned with Gate G1 and Gate G7.

title: Capture player-prop thresholds, two-way prices, and actual Same-Game Parlay (SGP) joint quotes
problem: props_model.py originates fair medians and copula lifts on 2019–2022 PBP, but zero historical prop prices or SGP multipliers exist in the repository.
proposal: Allows direct measurement of whether sportsbook SGP correlation taxes exceed or underprice empirical QB-WR, RB-ML, and defensive-deficiency prop dependencies.
options_a: Path A (Single-prop logging only): Log standalone two-way player-prop lines/odds for QB/RB/WR/TE starters and 2nd/3rd-string replacements.
options_b: Path B (Paired standalone + SGP quote capture — Recommended): Log both standalone prop legs and the exact quoted SGP price for the 7 pre-registered combo structures.
options_c: Path C (Full menu SGP scraper): Scrape all pairwise player combinations across every book.
risk: Path C explodes multiple-testing burden (hurting Gate G4/G5); Path B tests the exact pre-registered structural hypotheses without data-snooping inflation.

title: Separate 'Frozen Historical Benchmark' from a versioned 'Weekly Live Slate Snapshot' on lines.html
problem: Pinned snapshot a270278f3ac4 (2026-11-01) leaves 28 settled Week 8 & Week 9 games inside upcoming.csv/lines.html because refreshing the pin would alter historical backtest totals.
proposal: Prevents a reviewer from mistaking already-settled Week 8/9 games for open Week 10+ decisions while preserving 100% byte-reproducibility of historical backtests.
options_a: Path A (Status badge only): Keep single pin; annotate settled post-pin games via an official NFL.com reconciliation table (delivered in audit/readiness views).
options_b: Path B (Dual-pin architecture — Recommended): Freeze historical backtest pin (1999–2025) separately from a weekly-versioned 2026 schedule/score manifest updated every Tuesday.
options_c: Path C (Rolling re-pin on every build): Run --refresh-pin weekly and re-baseline all historical metrics.
risk: Path C shifts historical benchmark numbers every week; Path B gives live weekly decision utility AND immutable historical reproducibility.

title: Add a single-screen Matchup Decision Card combining originated line, injury string drops, and gate blockers
problem: To evaluate one game (e.g., NE vs DET or MIN @ GB), a user currently has to cross-reference lines.html, props.html,lineup-deficiencies.html, and flagged.html manually.
proposal: Cuts pre-decision review time and surfaces hidden disqualifiers (e.g., 3rd-string OL/RB cascade or unverified quote source) alongside the model estimate.
options_a: Path A (Static cross-links): Link matchup IDs across existing category tables.
options_b: Path B (Unified game-drawer / filterable matchup matrix — Recommended): Add a per-game expandable row showing fair line, offensive/defensive string deficiencies, and Go/Hold checklist.
options_c: Path C (Client-side interactive simulator): Allow users to toggle starter/backup status in-browser to preview sensitivity.
risk: Path C risks users over-fitting manual sliders; Path B presents verified facts and explicit blockers in one glance without inviting ad-hoc overrides.

title: Provide an explicit 'Strict Official View' vs 'Labelled Research Numbers View' toggle with persistent warning banner
problem: Strict public pages blank community-derived metrics (proper under verification policy), forcing reviewers to download CSVs or jump to lab/ to inspect exact MAE, Holm p, and DSR diagnostics.
proposal: Lets quantitative reviewers inspect failure modes (e.g., why all 18 strategies fail gates) directly in-table without ever conflating community estimates with official NFL facts.
options_a: Path A (Keep strict-only HTML + CSV links — current baseline): Zero risk of misreading community numbers as official.
options_b: Path B (Side-by-side 'Official Verified' and 'Unverified Research Diagnostic' columns — Recommended): Keep official columns blank where unconfirmed, and display watermarked diagnostic columns only in an explicitly opt-in research drawer.
options_c: Path C (Merge annex and canonical tables): Show all numbers inline with footnote disclaimers.
risk: Path C violates the strict blank-unverified verification rule; Path A (current) or a segregated diagnostic drawer (Path B) preserves strict provenance.

title: Model defensive secondary & front-seven backup cascades into opponent passing/rushing prop & total distributions
problem: props_model.py models offensive player usage solely from the player's own prior games, ignoring opposing defensive starter outs (e.g., NE CB1 Carlton Davis III Out, DET CB1 D.J. Reed DNP, GB LB1/EDGE1/NB1 DNP).
proposal: Captures asymmetric matchup edges where a healthy 1st-string offense (e.g., KC Mahomes/Rice/Kelce Full) faces a defense depleted to 2nd/3rd-string pass rushers and linebackers (ATL).
options_a: Path A (Qualitative matchup tag): Surface opposing defensive 1st/2nd/3rd-string absences next to offensive prop hypotheses.
options_b: Path B (Opponent unit-health covariate — Recommended): Add prior-only opponent pass/rush defensive efficiency adjusted for confirmed starter absences.
options_c: Path C (Individual CB-WR shadow matchup model): Estimate route-level coverage matchups.
risk: Path C requires proprietary tracking data (Next Gen Stats routes); Path B uses observable unit participation and avoids noisy small-sample shadow assumptions.

title: Establish an append-only git-signed Pre-Registration Trial Ledger before testing any new injury or prop signal
problem: validation.py uses TRIAL_REGISTER_LOWER_BOUND = 60 across canonical + historical + annex runs, leaving Deflated Sharpe provisional because earlier exploratory runs are uncounted.
proposal: Eliminates selection-bias ambiguity (Gate G5) so future strategies that pass prospective testing can be evaluated against an exact, auditable trial denominator N.
options_a: Path A (Manual markdown log): Record new strategy IDs in COORDINATION.md before coding.
options_b: Path B (CI-enforced pre-registration manifest — Recommended): Require every strategy ID, frozen rule hash, and timestamp in data/governance/trial_registry.csv prior to backtest execution.
options_c: Path C (External timestamping authority): Notarize strategy hashes externally before each NFL season.
risk: Path B is zero-cost, automated in GitHub Actions, and makes silent parameter tuning or deleted trials detectable in git history.

title: Incorporate the official T-90m roof/wall designation and certified pre-kickoff stadium weather lock
problem: Default models.py excludes temp/wind/roof because historical pre-kickoff timestamps were unverified; NFL Operations confirms retractable roof/wall state is reported at the 90-minute officiating meeting and locked at 60 minutes.
proposal: Unlocks verified indoor/outdoor and wind-total signals (e.g., TOT_HIGH_WIND_UNDER) for prospective games without historical imputation leakage.
options_a: Path A (Keep excluded): Continue omitting roof/weather until prospective archive reaches >=3 seasons.
options_b: Path B (Prospective T-60m lock logger — Recommended): Log stadium roof position and NWS station wind/temp at T-60m alongside the 90-minute inactive report.
options_c: Path C (Forecast weather feed at T-48h): Trade early openers on meteorological forecasts.
risk: Path B aligns strictly with the NFL Operations 90m/60m stadium-prep protocol and avoids forecast vendor drift.

title: Replace flat-unit ROI leaderboard tie-breaking with Closing-Line Value (CLV) + Brier skill score during paper trading
problem: With ~272 NFL games per season, binary win/loss ROI requires multiple seasons to achieve 80% statistical power at a 2% edge (Gate G3).
proposal: Accelerates detection of genuine line-origination skill (or model decay) during untouched prospective paper trading while keeping Gate G6 realized-profit requirements intact.
options_a: Path A (Realized ROI only): Wait multiple seasons for binary outcome convergence.
options_b: Path B (Dual diagnostic: CLV + realized weekly bootstrap — Recommended): Use timestamped entry-vs-close probability delta as Tier-2 paper-trading diagnostic, while still requiring realized net profit for Tier-3 replication.
options_c: Path C (CLV-only rewards): Award strategies purely on beating closing lines.
risk: Path C can be gamed in illiquid early markets or fail on correlated parlays; Path B improves statistical power without rewarding unprofitable CLV.

title: Define explicit competition governance, non-monetary recognition charter, and jurisdictional compliance sign-off
problem: Prompt frames signal discovery as a leaderboard competition with rewards; currently all rewards are 'Unawarded' and no funded pool, sponsor, or legal terms exist.
proposal: Prevents ambiguity over when a strategy qualifies for recognition and ensures research-only benchmarking never crosses into unauthorized wagering promotion.
options_a: Path A (Research badge tiers only — Recommended): Formalize non-monetary 'Candidate' and 'Replicated Skill' badges gated on all 8 gates + 2 untouched prospective windows.
options_b: Path B (Internal capital-allocation weightings): Allocate research paper-bankroll weights proportional to out-of-sample Kelly fraction capped at 1%.
options_c: Path C (External sponsored contest): Require legal counsel, escrow, and jurisdictional contest rules before any monetary prize.
risk: Path A delivers immediate competitive accountability with zero legal/custody risk while Gate G1/G7 evidence is still being accumulated.

recommended: Run the comparison over the full schedule archive and publish the match rate.
risk: Every game, every season, checked against an official source.

title: Record a complete trial registry: every model, feature, parameter and strategy variant ever tried, before evaluation.
problem: The deflated Sharpe is published as provisional.
proposal: The deflated Sharpe is only meaningful with the true number of trials. This is why it is provisional.
recommended: Compare the registry against the code history and confirm no unregistered variant exists.
risk: A frozen registry of all exploratory trials.

title: Add lineup-availability inputs to the line-origination models: QB tier, position-group pressure, and whether a starter is ruled out.
problem: Availability tables are now built and published on the injury page.
proposal: Availability is the most direct cause of line movement the models currently ignore entirely.
recommended: Check the feature is prefix-stable (no future availability) and re-run the leakage tests.
risk: A validated mapping from availability to expected points, fitted walk-forward.

title: Add opponent-specific defensive deficiency features by position group, not just a single team rating.
problem: Position-group pressure is measured for the current week.
proposal: The brief asks specifically about 2nd, 3rd and 4th string defenders replacing starters.
recommended: Confirm the feature exists only for games before the test fold and passes the no-lookahead test.
risk: A historical availability series matching the model's training window.

title: Split every feature into "known at decision time" and "known at settlement", and assert the split in code.
problem: Leakage checks exist for weather, scores and season splits.
proposal: Most availability information arrives after the line moves; using it at decision time is lookahead.
recommended: Add a test that deletes all post-kickoff fields and confirms the originate step still runs.
risk: An explicit decision-time / settlement-time feature split with an assertion.

title: Measure how the market prices a backup quarterback, and compare that with the model's own estimate.
problem: Descriptive estimate of backup-QB cost exists for 2006-2018.
proposal: A model that says "backup QB costs 4 points" is only useful if the market does not already price it.
recommended: Compare model-implied point adjustment against the movement in the quoted spread for the same games.
risk: Market-implied availability adjustment, computed from quoted lines.

title: Add an availability gate: the availability feature must beat the market out of sample, not merely improve the model.
problem: Eight fail-closed gates exist; none tests a single feature's market edge.
proposal: A feature can improve the model and still lose to the market. Only the comparison decides.
recommended: Run the gate on the historical window and publish the paired sample sizes.
risk: A feature-level out-of-sample test against the market benchmark.

title: Make prospective, untouched replication a mandatory gate before any recognition or reward.
problem: The gates require prospective replication in principle.
proposal: Backtests are the thing most likely to be wrong. Only forward observation tests a strategy.
recommended: Freeze the window, run it, and publish failures alongside successes.
risk: A frozen prospective window with logged decisions and settled results.

title: Recompute the deflated Sharpe with the registered trial count and publish the sensitivity.
problem: Deflated Sharpe is computed and published as provisional.
proposal: A provisional number that is never pinned is not a gate.
recommended: Recompute with the registry count and show the conclusion is unchanged.
risk: The complete trial registry (see S-11).

title: State the reward pool, its custody and its payout obligation before any award, or state plainly that none exists.
problem: Rewards are published as unawarded with a no-monetary-reward rule per tier.
proposal: The leaderboard currently ranks research candidates with no funded prize. That must never be read as a prize.
recommended: Confirm the page never implies a prize exists and that the unawarded state is visible.
risk: An explicit funding decision from the owner.

title: Add a replication tier that rewards an untouched prospective window, separate from backtest rank.
problem: Eligibility comes before rank in the published rules.
proposal: Ranking on backtest profit rewards variance and rewards the luckiest run.
recommended: Confirm the tier rule is frozen before any window opens.
risk: A funded, pre-registered replication tier.

title: Publish two leaderboards: an eligibility board and a risk-adjusted rank board, never a raw-profit board.
problem: The current board publishes eligibility and leaves performance blank.
proposal: Raw profit is the most misleading single number available and it is the one people look for.
recommended: Confirm no board on the site ranks by raw profit alone.
risk: A risk-adjusted rank board computed from weekly returns.

title: Keep the strict official-source row check in CI and make it fail the build.
problem: verify_site.py, check_sources.py and check_links.py already run in CI.
proposal: The brief requires every table row to link to an official site. A check that only warns will silently rot.
recommended: Confirm the workflow runs on pull requests and that a deliberately broken row fails it.
risk: Nothing. This is delivered.

title: Schedule a recurring rebuild and link check so the live site cannot drift from the pinned inputs.
problem: The pinned-SHA build is reproducible and hash-checked.
proposal: A site that is not rebuilt is a site that quietly lies about its snapshot.
recommended: Confirm the workflow exists, is enabled, and that a failed run is visible.
risk: A scheduled workflow with an owner and an alert on failure.

title: Add the official news feed to the availability model as a flagged, human-reviewed input rather than ignoring it.
problem: The news register is staged and published verbatim.
proposal: The report table alone missed six quarterback situations that official news captured on the same page.
recommended: Check that every flagged team has a source link and that no status is inferred from a headline.
risk: A structured, dated official source for roster moves and IR placements.

title: Build a market cross-check: does the spread move when a starter is ruled out, and by how much?
problem: No market reaction measurement exists yet.
proposal: This is the test that turns an availability observation into a pricing signal.
recommended: Pair each ruling-out event with the quoted line before and after it and publish the distribution.
risk: Timestamped ruling-out events joined to quote movements.
